text.p: British retailer Dixons Group Plc could face a formal inquiry by the Office of Fair Trading over alleged "strong-arm tactics" to have rivals excluded from out-of-town shopping centres, the London Times reported.
The paper said the chain had been accused of using an "unfair and competitive" strategy to force developers of out-of-town centres to deny floor space to Dixons' rivals.
The Times said it had seen documents in which the OFT wrote to many of Dixons' competitors asking for information last month.
"We are considering a complaint against Dixons Group concerning its policy in regard to leasing space on retail parks," it quoted the letter as saying.
